_about: Shared test vector for AISH Article JSON v1 and the Markdown note (plugin/formats/article-json-v1.md). The extension builds `expectedJson` and `expectedMarkdown` from `input` (test168); the Android app builds the front matter from `android.message` (ArticleMarkdownTest) and must equal `android.expectedFrontMatter` (the same keys, minus mood and tags, which the phone does not know). `names` pins stable file names.
